title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Blackcurrant Cotton K / Blue Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This set pairs a confectionery-style Blackcurrant Cotton K with a clear, bright Blue Raspberry profile. Blackcurrant Cotton K brings a soft spun-sugar note to rich dark berry, while Blue Raspberry delivers a sweet–tart berry taste with a clean finish. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, each pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so both refills can be loaded together and switched on the device. A mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt deliver smooth MTL vapour, clear flavour delivery and rapid nicotine satisfaction from either refill. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
